title: Strictly bounded, manually triggered, Solana-only, GMGN-only 20-wallet statistical profile pilot
objective: Based on verified Chain.fm SOL address cleaning output, perform a strictly bounded, manually triggered, Solana-only, GMGN-only 20-wallet statistical pilot. For 20 deterministically selected addresses, fetch and normalize GMGN 7D and 30D wallet stats, collecting only allowlisted metrics with source=gmgn, verification_status=unverified, completeness, warning/error codes, and fetchedAt watermark. The result is a borrowed initial screening record output to an external directory, not a confirmed on-chain PnL, wallet quality grade, or Alpha tier.
forbidden_actions: Do not call BSC, Robinhood, multichain, or any chain other than Solana.
Do not use web scraping, browser automation, Cloudflare bypass, or non-official endpoints.
Do not execute trades, signatures, transfers, or orders.
Do not execute cron, background loops, auto-discovery, or automatic daily updates.
Do not call Helius or perform on-chain verification in this task.
Do not write to databases, Redis, queues, or production systems.
Do not print, persist, or commit API keys, private keys, raw payloads, raw errors, or full user address lists in Git.
Do not claim GMGN metrics are chain-confirmed facts, and do not use LLMs to score or explain individual wallets.
